data: A 4-km main-belt C-type named for the discoverer of the Lucy hominid fossil. Added late in Lucy's mission design as a bonus en-route flyby (2025-04-20, 960 km closest approach at 13.4 km/s) — a chance to test instruments before the harder Trojan encounters.

4-km main-belt C-type asteroid named for the discoverer of the Lucy hominid fossil. Bonus target added to Lucy's itinerary late in mission design to test instruments before the Trojan encounters. Closest approach 920 km at 13.4 km/s on 2025-04-20.
52246 Donaldjohanson is a main-belt asteroid (named after Lucy fossil discoverer) — NASA Lucy flew by on 20 April 2025 as its first belt encounter.
A planet that almost was — the rocky remnants between Mars and Jupiter that Jupiter's gravity wouldn't let coalesce.
